Else, you need to leave directly from work.
While running at the Night Run, you run and drink at the same time.
In the end, you receive your final running time.

result.process_description:
Title: App For Participating at the Vienna Night Run

If you want to participate at the Vienna Night Run, you need to select a starting block first.
After that, you run for 5km and measure the time.
If you can do it in less than 25 minutes, you are good.
If not, you need to train and check until you have achieved this goal.
After that, you can get your starting number.
Depending on when your work day ends, you have to find out whether you can go there from home, or need to leave directly from work.
If more than one hour is left between your starting time and the end of your workday, you can go there from home.
Else, you need to leave directly from work.
While running at the Night Run, you run and drink at the same time.
In the end, you receive your final running time.

Some of the above information you have to enter into the app, some of the information is collected by fitness gadgets.

Use a parallel split when all outgoing branches start. Do not add decision conditions to parallel branches.
Distinguish message tasks from message events: a task models performed work; an event models a message occurrence affecting flow.
An ordinary embedded subprocess participates in normal sequence flow and may contain its own starts, ends, activities, gateways and flows.
Model every distinct activity, event, participant, decision, branch, loop, message and outcome stated in the description. Do not invent process facts.
Use lanes to partition one process by a stated role, department, system or responsibility; lanes are not separate processes.

result.rule: When When a description names multiple distinct activities within one phase and states that the process continues only after every activity is finished,: model the activities as parallel branches with a parallel split and join, rather than as a sequence.

When the description says that independent activities proceed while other work is underway and that a later activity depends on all of them being complete: Model the concurrent activities with a parallel split, then synchronize all required branches with a parallel join before the dependent activity.

When the description states that an ongoing activity continues while a separate review or decision proceeds: model the activities as concurrent paths with a parallel gateway, and synchronize them before any later step that depends on both paths being complete

When the description states that a later activity can occur only after multiple independent activities or steps have all been completed: Model the required paths as parallel branches and join them with a parallel gateway before the later activity.
